about: The Mumbai 2026 photographs on the website (20-21 Nov 2026, World Trade Center Mumbai). Built by scripts/gen-mumbai-photos.mjs from Downloads/bharatai-site-photos/<slug>.jpg. pid = the photo-store id (R2 event-photos/1/<pid>/), so the same photo can be found among the 4,600 in Admin. use: hero = a home hero frame (in this order, seven of them), home = the home page, delhi = /delhi and /delhi-hi. Chosen 23 Nov 2026: full halls only, no rows of empty chairs, no close-up of a private attendee.
